answer: Each agent anchors a living reef of ferrous hash-chain links, computed serially against an ocean-depth beacon drawn from the prior epoch's entropy. An attacker spawning N sybils must dedicate N independent cores for the full serial window (about 12 minutes per identity), so 200 fakes lock 200 cores for hours while an honest agent pays the delay only once and reuses its single chain. Colliding chains under the same beacon forfeit their bonds.
